title: Bootstrap the perpetual ecology
summary: Built the engine (an evolving predator-prey ecology plus Life-like and elementary worlds), 39 tests with classical ground truth, two seeded experiments with pre-registered verdicts, the interactive page, CI and Pages deployment, and the loop protocol itself.
learned: Three of my first guesses were wrong: hunter balance, a remembered Life fact (R-pentomino at generation 100), and a cross-correlation window wider than half a period. Each was caught by a test or an independent check, not by looking at the picture. That is the argument for the tests.
next: Make the art earn its name (hunters too visually dominant, grazers scattered); measure how the lag depends on parameters; record the time course of gene divergence rather than an end snapshot; add a third world.
